description: Unusual options activity for a stock, ETF or index from Cboe's delayed quotes: contracts trading at least as many times their open interest as asked (new positions more likely than closing), ranked by the premium that changed hands, with strike, expiry, IV and delta, and the day's call and put premium.

limit.description: Most contracts, largest premium first; default 20.

min_ratio.description: Volume at least this many times the open interest; default 1.

min_volume.description: Only contracts with at least this many traded today; default 100.

symbol.description: A stock or ETF (AAPL, SPY) or an index (SPX, NDX).

name: unusual_options

outputSchema.description: rows are the flagged contracts, largest premium first, in the order of columns.

title: Unusual options activity (Cboe)
